correctness.rationale: Factor the group algebra at the odd m-th roots and the dyadic nilpotent local factors. Multiplication by X+X^-1 has two J_{M/2}(0) blocks; at zeta=1 the Y contribution is double-nilpotent, whereas for zeta !=1 the shifted multiplier has a simple local zero. The change of coordinates K[u,v]/(u^r,v^s), with r,s powers of two, makes multiplication by u+v a direct sum of min(r,s) blocks of size max(r,s). This proves the displayed zero/nonzero Jordan blocks including d=1; ranks and dimensions sum to Mmd. The cyclic module/gcd root condition gives fixed populations and Mobius inversion exact period counts; Fitting decomposition counts first-entry shells. Direct independent GF(2) matrix-power nullities for 4x3 and 4x5 at t=1,2,3,4,6 agree with the formulas.
